images.view: High aerial view from a distance, with the whole research complex visible inside the frame.
images.detail: A ring of slender antennas surrounds the dome.
images.site: It stands on a flat plateau of dark neutral grey rock at the top of a towering dark neutral grey rock cliff, open to the sky, on a lifeless alien planet of bare rock.
images.subject: A research laboratory complex built around one immense glass dome, with glowing scientific instruments visible inside it. On the right side of the frame, on the plateau beside the dome, a second large and clearly separate block: a tall observatory tower topped by a large white radio telescope dish pointing at the sky. On the left side of the plateau, a third large and clearly separate block: a wide low circular particle accelerator building whose ring glows with bright blue light through long windows.
